- خرج I0.0 (بادئ التشغيل) -> set-topic-i00

  .m2wire-green  { stroke:#00FF55; stroke-dasharray: none; animation: m2fz-flow 0.8s linear infinite; }
  .m2wire-yellow { stroke:#FFC107; stroke-dasharray: 12 12; animation: m2fz-flow-yellow 1.2s linear infinite; }
  .m2wire-red    { stroke:#FF3030; stroke-dasharray: none; animation: m2fz-flow-red 0.6s linear infinite; }
  @keyframes m2fz-flow { to { stroke-dashoffset: -32; } }
  @keyframes m2fz-flow-yellow { to { stroke-dashoffset: -48; } }
  @keyframes m2fz-flow-red { to { stroke-dashoffset: -24; } }

<script>
(function(scope) {
  // ============================================================
  // بيانات المكونات (المفاتيح بنفس IDs المستخدمة في onclick)
  // ============================================================
  const componentData = {
    'km0': { name: 'QF0 - قاطع التيار الرئيسي', function: 'يغذي اللوحة بالكهرباء 3 فاز 380V' },
    'm1_qf': { name: 'QF1 - قاطع حماية M1', function: 'يحمي دائرة M1 من التيار الزائد' },
    'm1_km': { name: 'KM1 - كونتاكتور M1', function: 'يصل الطاقة للموتور M1 بأمر من SB3 (Hardwired)' },
    'm1_fr': { name: 'FR1 - أوفرلود M1', function: 'يحمي الموتور M1 من التيار الزائد' },
    'm1_motor': { name: 'M1 - موتور الناقل الأمامي', function: '0.18kW - 4pole 1330/129r/min' },
    'm2_qf': { name: 'QF2 - قاطع حماية M2', function: 'يحمي دائرة M2 من التيار الزائد' },
    'm2_km': { name: 'KM2 - كونتاكتور M2', function: 'يصل الطاقة للموتور M2 بأمر من LOGO Q1' },
    'm2_fr': { name: 'FR2 - أوفرلود M2', function: 'يحمي الموتور M2 من التيار الزائد (Hardwired)' },
    'm2_motor': { name: 'M2 - موتور الفريزر', function: '0.55kW - 4pole 1360/147r/min' },
    'm3_qf': { name: 'QF3 - قاطع حماية M3', function: 'يحمي دائرة M3 من التيار الزائد' },
    'm3_km': { name: 'KM3 - كونتاكتور M3', function: 'يصل الطاقة للموتور M3 بأمر من SB5 (Hardwired)' },
    'm3_fr': { name: 'FR3 - أوفرلود M3', function: 'يحمي الموتور M3 من التيار الزائد' },
    'm3_motor': { name: 'M3 - موتور الناقل الخلفي', function: '0.18kW - 4pole 1330/129r/min' },
    'm4_qf': { name: 'QF4 - قاطع حماية M4', function: 'يحمي دائرة M4 من التيار الزائد' },
    'm4_vfd': { name: 'VFD - إنفرتر القطع', function: 'يتحكم في سرعة موتور M4 ويتلقى أمر RUN من LOGO DM8 Q2' },
    'm4_motor': { name: 'M4 - موتور القطع', function: '0.75kW - 4pole 1380/58r/min مع VFD' },
    'm2_plc_q': { name: 'LOGO M1-Q2', function: 'خرج LOGO لتشغيل M2' },
    'm4_plc_q': { name: 'LOGO DM8-Q2', function: 'خرج LOGO لتشغيل VFD M4' },
    'm4_enable': { name: 'تفعيل VFD', function: 'يأمر VFD بالتشغيل بعد استقبال RUN' },
    'plc_main': { name: 'Siemens LOGO! 12/24RC + DM8', function: 'الوحدة المنطقية الرئيسية للتحكم في M2 و M4' }
  };

  // تخزين آخر تغيير
  let lastChangeTime = {};
  let currentDisplayedComponent = null;

  // ============================================================
  // دالة عرض المعلومات (بتظهر لما تدوس على المكون)
  // ============================================================
  window.showInfo = function(compId, displayName, funcDesc) {
    const content = document.getElementById('infoContent');
    if (!content) return;

    // تسجيل المكون المعروض حالياً
    currentDisplayedComponent = compId;

    // استخدام الاسم المعروض إذا موجود، وإلا نستخدم الـ displayName
    const data = componentData[compId] || { 
      name: displayName || compId, 
      function: funcDesc || 'مكون غير معروف' 
    };
    const lastTime = lastChangeTime[compId] || 'لم يتغير بعد';

    // معرفة الحالة الحالية من العنصر نفسه
    const stateEl = document.getElementById(compId + '_body');
    let currentState = '⚫ غير معروف';
    if (stateEl) {
      if (stateEl.classList.contains('state-green') || stateEl.classList.contains('plc-green') || stateEl.classList.contains('motor-green')) {
        currentState = '🟢 شغال';
      } else if (stateEl.classList.contains('state-yellow') || stateEl.classList.contains('motor-yellow')) {
        currentState = '🟡 مستني أمر';
      } else if (stateEl.classList.contains('state-red') || stateEl.classList.contains('plc-red') || stateEl.classList.contains('motor-red')) {
        currentState = '🔴 عطل';
      } else {
        currentState = '⚫ مفصول';
      }
    }

    content.innerHTML = `
      <div class="row"><span class="label">🔹 اسم المكون</span><span class="value highlight">${data.name}</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">⚡ وظيفته</span><span class="value">${data.function}</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">📊 حالتك دلوقتي</span><span class="value">${currentState}</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">⏱️ آخر مره اتغيرت</span><span class="value">${lastTime}</span></div>
    `;
  };

  // ============================================================
  // تحديث لوحة المعلومات لو المكون المعروض اتغير
  // ============================================================
  function updateInfoPanelIfVisible(compId) {
    if (currentDisplayedComponent === compId) {
      const content = document.getElementById('infoContent');
      if (!content) return;
      
      const data = componentData[compId] || { name: compId, function: 'مكون غير معروف' };
      const lastTime = lastChangeTime[compId] || 'لم يتغير بعد';
      
      const stateEl = document.getElementById(compId + '_body');
      let currentState = '⚫ غير معروف';
      if (stateEl) {
        if (stateEl.classList.contains('state-green') || stateEl.classList.contains('plc-green') || stateEl.classList.contains('motor-green')) {
          currentState = '🟢 شغال';
        } else if (stateEl.classList.contains('state-yellow') || stateEl.classList.contains('motor-yellow')) {
          currentState = '🟡 مستني أمر';
        } else if (stateEl.classList.contains('state-red') || stateEl.classList.contains('plc-red') || stateEl.classList.contains('motor-red')) {
          currentState = '🔴 عطل';
        } else {
          currentState = '⚫ مفصول';
        }
      }
      
      content.innerHTML = `
        <div class="row"><span class="label">🔹 اسم المكون</span><span class="value highlight">${data.name}</span></div>
        <div class="row"><span class="label">⚡ وظيفته</span><span class="value">${data.function}</span></div>
        <div class="row"><span class="label">📊 حالتك دلوقتي</span><span class="value">${currentState}</span></div>
        <div class="row"><span class="label">⏱️ آخر مره اتغيرت</span><span class="value">${lastTime}</span></div>
      `;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // دوال تحديث العناصر (بتسجل وقت التغيير)
  // ============================================================
  function setElementState(id, state) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    
    const oldGreen = el.classList.contains('state-green');
    const oldYellow = el.classList.contains('state-yellow');
    const oldRed = el.classList.contains('state-red');
    const oldOff = el.classList.contains('state-off');
    
    el.classList.remove('state-off','state-green','state-yellow','state-red');
    
    if (state === 1) el.classList.add('state-green');
    else if (state === 2) el.classList.add('state-red');
    else if (state === 0) el.classList.add('state-yellow');
    else el.classList.add('state-off');
    
    const newGreen = el.classList.contains('state-green');
    const newYellow = el.classList.contains('state-yellow');
    const newRed = el.classList.contains('state-red');
    const newOff = el.classList.contains('state-off');
    
    // لو اتغيرت الحالة، نسجل الوقت
    if (oldGreen !== newGreen || oldYellow !== newYellow || oldRed !== newRed || oldOff !== newOff) {
      // استخراج الـ compId من الـ id (نشيل _body)
      const compId = id.replace('_body', '');
      const now = new Date();
      lastChangeTime[compId] = now.toLocaleTimeString('ar-EG') + ' ' + now.toLocaleDateString('ar-EG');
      updateInfoPanelIfVisible(compId);
    }
  }

  function setMotorState(id, state) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    
    const oldGreen = el.classList.contains('motor-green');
    const oldYellow = el.classList.contains('motor-yellow');
    const oldRed = el.classList.contains('motor-red');
    const oldOff = el.classList.contains('motor-off');
    
    el.classList.remove('motor-off','motor-green','motor-yellow','motor-red');
    
    if (state === 1) el.classList.add('motor-green');
    else if (state === 2) el.classList.add('motor-red');
    else if (state === 0) el.classList.add('motor-yellow');
    else el.classList.add('motor-off');
    
    const newGreen = el.classList.contains('motor-green');
    const newYellow = el.classList.contains('motor-yellow');
    const newRed = el.classList.contains('motor-red');
    const newOff = el.classList.contains('motor-off');
    
    if (oldGreen !== newGreen || oldYellow !== newYellow || oldRed !== newRed || oldOff !== newOff) {
      const compId = id.replace('_body', '');
      const now = new Date();
      lastChangeTime[compId] = now.toLocaleTimeString('ar-EG') + ' ' + now.toLocaleDateString('ar-EG');
      updateInfoPanelIfVisible(compId);
    }
  }

  function setPlcState(id, state) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    
    const oldGreen = el.classList.contains('plc-green');
    const oldRed = el.classList.contains('plc-red');
    const oldOff = el.classList.contains('plc-off');
    
    el.classList.remove('plc-off','plc-green','plc-red');
    
    if (state === 1) el.classList.add('plc-green');
    else if (state === 2) el.classList.add('plc-red');
    else el.classList.add('plc-off');
    
    const newGreen = el.classList.contains('plc-green');
    const newRed = el.classList.contains('plc-red');
    const newOff = el.classList.contains('plc-off');
    
    if (oldGreen !== newGreen || oldRed !== newRed || oldOff !== newOff) {
      const compId = id.replace('_body', '');
      const now = new Date();
      lastChangeTime[compId] = now.toLocaleTimeString('ar-EG') + ' ' + now.toLocaleDateString('ar-EG');
      updateInfoPanelIfVisible(compId);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // باقي الدوال (setWire, setLed, setCoil, setContact, setText)
  // ============================================================
  function setWire(id, state) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('m2wire-off','m2wire-green','m2wire-yellow','m2wire-red');
    if (state === 1) el.classList.add('m2wire-green');
    else if (state === 2) el.classList.add('m2wire-red');
    else if (state === 0) el.classList.add('m2wire-yellow');
    else el.classList.add('m2wire-off');
  }

  function setLed(id, state) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('m2led-off','m2led-green','m2led-yellow','m2led-red');
    if (state === 1) el.classList.add('m2led-green');
    else if (state === 2) el.classList.add('m2led-red');
    else if (state === 0) el.classList.add('m2led-yellow');
    else el.classList.add('m2led-off');
  }

  function setCoil(id, state) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('m2coil-green','m2coil-yellow','m2coil-red');
    if (state === 1) el.classList.add('m2coil-green');
    else if (state === 2) el.classList.add('m2coil-red');
    else if (state === 0) el.classList.add('m2coil-yellow');
  }

  function setContact(id, state) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('m2contact-green','m2contact-yellow','m2contact-red');
    if (state === 1) el.classList.add('m2contact-green');
    else if (state === 2) el.classList.add('m2contact-red');
    else if (state === 0) el.classList.add('m2contact-yellow');
  }

  function setText(id, text) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.textContent = text;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // مراقبة الـ msg
  // ============================================================
  scope.$watch('msg', function(msg) {
    if (!msg || !msg.payload) return;
    const p = msg.payload;
    const sys = p.system;
    const io = p.io || {};
    const motors = p.motors;
    const seq = p.sequence;

    setPlcState('plc_main_body', sys.plc_run ? 1 : 2);

    const km0_state = (sys.main_power && sys.mcb) ? 1 : 0;
    setElementState('km0_body', km0_state);
    setLed('led_km0', km0_state);
    setWire('wire_km0_out', km0_state);

    function updateMotor(prefix, data, isVfd) {
      const power_in = isVfd ? data.power_in : data.contactor_in;
      const coil_energized = data.coil_energized || false;
      const contactor_out = data.contactor_out || false;
      const fr_ok = data.fr_ok !== undefined ? data.fr_ok : true;
      const tripped = data.tripped || false;
      const running = data.running || false;
      const cmd = data.km_command || data.vfd_run || false;

      setElementState(prefix + '_qf_body', power_in ? 1 : 0);
      setLed(prefix + '_qf', power_in ? 1 : 0);
      setWire(prefix + '_qf_km', power_in ? 1 : 0);

      let km_state = 0;
      if (contactor_out) km_state = 1;
      else if (power_in && coil_energized) km_state = 2;
      else if (power_in) km_state = 0;
      setElementState(prefix + '_km_body', km_state);
      setLed(prefix + '_km', km_state);
      setWire(prefix + '_km_fr', km_state);

      let fr_state = 0;
      if (fr_ok && contactor_out) fr_state = 1;
      else if (!fr_ok && contactor_out) fr_state = 2;
      else if (contactor_out) fr_state = 0;
      setElementState(prefix + '_fr_body', fr_state);
      setLed(prefix + '_fr', fr_state);

      let motor_state = 0;
      if (running) motor_state = 1;
      else if (tripped) motor_state = 2;
      else if (contactor_out) motor_state = 0;
      setMotorState(prefix + '_motor_body', motor_state);
      setLed(prefix + '_motor', motor_state);
      setWire(prefix + '_fr_motor', (running || data.overload_out) ? 1 : (contactor_out && tripped ? 2 : 0));

      let coil_state = 0;
      if (coil_energized) coil_state = 1;
      else if (cmd && sys.plc_run && power_in) coil_state = 2;
      else if (power_in) coil_state = 0;
      setCoil(prefix + '_coil', coil_state);
      if (!isVfd) setCoil(prefix + '_coil_ladder', coil_state);

      if (prefix === 'm1' || prefix === 'm3') {
        const startCmd = data.km_command;
        const frOk = data.fr_ok;
        setContact(prefix + '_contact_start', startCmd ? 1 : 0);
        setContact(prefix + '_contact_stop', 1);
        setContact(prefix + '_contact_fr', frOk ? 1 : (contactor_out ? 2 : 0));
        const start_out = (startCmd && frOk) ? 1 : (startCmd ? 0 : 0);
        setWire(prefix + '_start_out', start_out);
        setWire(prefix + '_stop_out', start_out);
        setWire(prefix + '_fr_out', start_out);
        setWire(prefix + '_hold_branch', (data.km_aux_ok && data.running && coil_energized) ? 1 : 0);
      }

      if (prefix === 'm2') {
        let plc_out_state = 0;
        if (coil_energized) plc_out_state = 1;
        else if (data.km_command && sys.plc_run) plc_out_state = 2;
        else if (sys.plc_run) plc_out_state = 0;
        setElementState('m2_plc_q_body', data.km_command ? 1 : 0);
        setLed('led_m2_plc_q', data.km_command ? 1 : 0);
        setWire('wire_m2_plc_out', plc_out_state);
      }

      if (isVfd) {
        let vfd_state = 0;
        if (running) vfd_state = 1;
        else if (data.vfd_enabled) vfd_state = 2;
        else if (data.vfd_run) vfd_state = 0;
        setElementState(prefix + '_vfd_body', vfd_state);
        setLed(prefix + '_vfd', vfd_state);
        setWire('wire_m4_vfd_motor', vfd_state);
        setElementState('m4_enable_body', (data.vfd_run && sys.plc_run) ? 1 : 0);
        setLed('led_m4_vfd_enable', (data.vfd_run && sys.plc_run) ? 1 : 0);
        setLed('led_m4_plc_run', data.vfd_run ? 1 : 0);
        setWire('wire_m4_plc_run', data.vfd_run && sys.plc_run ? 1 : 0);
        setElementState('m4_plc_q_body', data.vfd_run ? 1 : 0);
      }

      const diagDiv = document.getElementById('diag_' + prefix);
      if (diagDiv) {
        const diag = data.diagnostics || [];
        if (diag.length === 0) {
          diagDiv.innerHTML = '<span class="none">لا يوجد أعطال</span>';
        } else {
          diagDiv.innerHTML = diag.map(d => 
            `<span style="display:block;padding:4px 0;font-size:13px;color:#FF3030;">⚠️ ${d.en}</span>`
          ).join('');
        }
      }
    }

    updateMotor('m1', motors.m1, false);
    updateMotor('m2', motors.m2, false);
    updateMotor('m3', motors.m3, false);
    updateMotor('m4', motors.m4, true);

    function updateIoLed(id, txtId, val) {
      setLed(id, val ? 1 : 0);
      setText(txtId, val ? 'ON' : 'OFF');
    }
    updateIoLed('led_plc_i1', 'txt_plc_i1', io.sq1 || false);
    updateIoLed('led_plc_i2', 'txt_plc_i2', io.sb7 || false);
    updateIoLed('led_plc_i3', 'txt_plc_i3', io.sq2 || false);
    updateIoLed('led_plc_i4', 'txt_plc_i4', io.sq3 || false);
    updateIoLed('led_plc_i5', 'txt_plc_i5', io.sa1_pos1 || false);
    updateIoLed('led_plc_i6', 'txt_plc_i6', io.sa1_pos2 || false);
    updateIoLed('led_plc_i7', 'txt_plc_i7', io.sa1_pos3 || false);
    updateIoLed('led_plc_i8', 'txt_plc_i8', false);
    updateIoLed('led_plc_dm8_i1', 'txt_plc_dm8_i1', io.sq4 || false);
    updateIoLed('led_plc_dm8_i2', 'txt_plc_dm8_i2', io.sq5_sq6 || false);
    updateIoLed('led_plc_dm8_i4', 'txt_plc_dm8_i4', io.sb8 || false);
    setLed('led_plc_q1', motors.m2.km_command ? 1 : 0);
    setText('txt_plc_q1', motors.m2.km_command ? 'ON' : 'OFF');
    setLed('led_plc_q2', motors.m4.vfd_run ? 1 : 0);
    setText('txt_plc_q2', motors.m4.vfd_run ? 'ON' : 'OFF');

    const seqKeys = ['0','1','2','3','4'];
    const seqValues = [seq.step0, seq.step1, seq.step2, seq.step3, seq.step4];
    seqKeys.forEach((k, idx) => {
      setLed('seq_led_' + k, seqValues[idx] ? 1 : 0);
      if (idx < seqKeys.length - 1) {
        setWire('seq_arrow_' + k, (seqValues[idx] && seqValues[idx+1]) ? 1 : 0);
      }
    });
  });
})(scope);
</script>
